proof_summary: At \(n=473165\), the interior number \(K=a(n)+4=5292270077783\) is odd and lies strictly between the two proposed endpoints.  A covering of all exponents modulo \(48\) shows that \(K2^m+1\) has a proper divisor among \(3,5,7,17,257,97,673\): these apply respectively when \(m\equiv0\pmod2,\ 3\pmod4,\ 1\pmod3,\ 1\pmod8,\ 5\pmod{16},\ 29\pmod{48},\ 45\pmod{48}\), so \(K\) is itself a Sierpiński number and the endpoints are not consecutive.
